notes: Curated eval for evidence-led impact narratives. Routing keeps the story separate from KPI-tree and instrumentation design. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please create leadership-ready enablement impact narratives and, only when the evidence supports it, financial ROI analysis with explicit assumptions and risks.
I need an enablement impact story, executive summary, board-ready narrative, initiative outcome update, or defensible ROI calculation tied to performance and strategic priorities.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable enablement impact story and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please define revenue enablement KPI trees and measurement plans that connect enablement work to business outcomes.
Design the KPI tree and instrumentation plan so we can measure this onboarding program going forward.
Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please synthesize multi-source field feedback into traceable themes, segment differences, evidence limits, and owner-ready actions for enablement, product marketing, sales leadership, or product.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-claim-mode
output_structure_checks.description: Makes evidence limits clear beside the relevant claim. A short update need not name a formal claim mode or include a separate cannot-claim section.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-movement-table
output_structure_checks.description: Shows definition, population, baseline, current value, and comparable windows for each change claim.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-roi-gate
output_structure_checks.description: Calculates financial ROI only with supportable incremental cost and monetised attributable benefit. Does not add an ROI discussion when it does not affect the requested decision.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-no-invention
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent win rates, usage, ROI, or a measurement system in place of the narrative.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-story-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Preserves an accurate short draft and its recommendation; does not expand it into a measurement plan or introduce irrelevant financial caveats.

task_scenarios.prompt: Tighten this into an update of no more than 120 words for our COO. Keep any wording that already works. Cohort A: 30 new AEs, median time to independently run discovery was 42 days, versus 51 days for the previous 28 hires using the same definition. This was the first cohort using our practice programme. We also changed hiring criteria and manager coverage. We have no comparison design or complete cost figure. Draft: The new cohort reached independent discovery nine days sooner than the previous cohort. The practice programme may have contributed, but hiring criteria and manager coverage also changed. We recommend continuing the programme while checking whether the next cohort sustains the improvement. Please make the recommendation clear, but don't turn this into a measurement project.

assertions.name: enablement-impact-story-short-clean-update-1
assertions.description: Returns no more than 120 words, retains useful original wording, and makes a bounded continuation recommendation.

assertions.name: enablement-impact-story-short-clean-update-2
assertions.description: Preserves the nine-day observed difference and the alternative explanations; does not imply that the programme caused it.

assertions.name: enablement-impact-story-short-clean-update-3
assertions.description: Does not require a full memo, new metrics, ROI analysis, or an evaluation project.
